svg.title: Nonlinear invariant generation with one low coefficient ring
svg.desc: For the translation action on (1+p squared)u_xx=u_xy, p=u_x,r=u_y,q=u_xy,s=u_yy, f=1+p squared and delta=qs/f-q squared. Both f and delta are inverted in the order-two ring. The two horizontal forms have determinant delta. At order three Q1=a/q-2psq squared/(f squared delta),S1=(sa-qb)/delta with a=u_xyy,b=u_yyy, and the exact affine inverse is displayed. At every order h+2 the symbol rows of Q_h=nabla1^h q and S_h=nabla1^h s have triangular matrix with diagonal q^-h and(-q/delta)^h, determinant(-1/delta)^h. Every next quotient adds the affine plane with coordinates Q_h,S_h.

g.text: Nonlinear invariant generation with one low coefficient ring
p=uₓ, r=uᵧ, q=uₓᵧ, s=uᵧᵧ; f=1+p², δ=qs/f−q²; f ≠ 0 and δ ≠ 0.
Order two: B = K[p,r,q,s,f⁻¹,δ⁻¹] and F₂ = K(p,r,q,s)
dₕp=(q/f)dx+q dy; dₕr=q dx+s dy. Their determinant is δ.
The two inverses f⁻¹ and δ⁻¹ remain in the low ring throughout.
No inverse of a higher coordinate occurs.
Every order h+2: Qₕ=∇₁ʰq, Sₕ=∇₁ʰs, h ≥ 0
Standard symbol basis: (tₓtᵧʰ⁺¹, tᵧʰ⁺²). The two rows are triangular:
Cₕ = f[(s/f−q)ʰ−(−q)ʰ]/δʰ. The binomial proof gives all h, not a finite sample.
Actual inverse affine changes give independent polynomial coordinates in every degree.
X₂ ← X₃ ← X₄ ← ⋯ ; each step forgets its newest pair (Qₕ,Sₕ).
Translation isotropy is {id}; each fixed-basic-point Xⱼ is its own geometric quotient.
